title: Japanese Fish Soup
description: A traditional Japanese soup made with fish and vegetables, served steaming hot. This recipe is easy to make and is perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Fish (any white fish)
ingredients.notes: Cut the fish into small pieces

ingredients.name: Dashi (Japanese broth)
ingredients.notes: You can use store-bought dashi or make your own

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrot and potato and cook for another 5 minutes.
Add the fish and cook until it starts to flake, about 5 minutes.
Add the dashi, soy sauce, and miso paste, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the soup has thickened and the fish is cooked through.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with whipped cream if desired.
Optional: add some malaysian flavors like coconut milk or spices to give it a twist.
